真实工作流执行与分支

主管点击受理后，执行记录生成 Resolved 运行：#1 普通请求 isUrgent=false 并执行 Record normal acceptance；#2 紧急请求 isUrgent=true 并执行 Record urgent acceptance，业务结果分别为 Accepted/Normal 与 Accepted as urgent/Urgent。

持久站内通知

负责人消息中心收到 2 条 In-app 消息，分别对应正确请求；点击 Open 分别打开请求 #2 与 #1；标记已读后整页刷新及退出重登仍为已读。

收件人范围

主管与管理员的消息中心均为空，仅负责人可见这两条个人消息，说明消息按收件人隔离。

NocoBase3 基础框架评测

独立 Agent 评审 · 口径 v2
评的是库、插件与指引是否满足需求、容易使用、对 Agent 友好。业务代码与 QA 是使用证据，不是评分主体。 未评估不是零分或满分，不计算综合平均分。

评审源产物：Run 35996341913 / attempt 1。发布重试不改变评审源产物编号。

本次是以 Workflow 与持久站内通知为唯一范围的回归。评估覆盖 app-plugin-workflow、app-plugin-notification、app-plugin-notification-in-app 三个能力单元及其 Skill 指引。框架的 DSL/条件分支/run 节点/持久执行记录、Notification 的 Channel-Provider 发送与幂等、In-App 持久收件箱（用户隔离、CSRF、已读持久化、公开 Client 组件）在 QA 第 4 轮均真实通过。主要缺口是 Workflow 公开服务契约只有 trigger(key)/registerInstruction：应用自有 source workflow 在新部署没有 current revision 时 trigger(key) 只会得到 skipped: not-found，Agent 只能本地扩展接口调用未公开的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision 并传 force/waitForCompletion 才能由业务动作触发。该绕行违反 Skill 明示的“只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部”。通知与站内收件箱两项为直接支持且契约与 Skill 描述一致。

需求 → 框架职责 → 推荐与实际接入

主管点击受理后由现有 Workflow 执行“登记受理→按紧急标记分支→发送通知”，执行记录能看到步骤与最终结果（B01/B03）。需要绕行
框架职责与业务边界
框架负责 DSL、条件分支、run 节点执行、持久执行历史与触发 API；应用负责 workflow 源码、run 模块业务逻辑与触发时机。
推荐使用方式
在 server/workflows/<key>/workflow.ts 用 defineWorkflow + RunInstruction/ConditionInstruction 编写并校验；业务触发从容器解析 workflowServiceToken 调 trigger(key, input, { eventKey }) 并处理 accepted/skipped。
Agent 实际使用
Agent 按 DSL 正确编写 workflow.ts 与 run 模块（E10、E11、E12）。但 trigger(key) 在全新部署无 current revision 时只会 skipped: not-found，Agent 把 workflowServiceToken 转成自建 WorkflowRuntime 接口，调用未公开的 discoverArtifacts()/ensureArtifactMaterialized()/triggerRevision() 并传 force+waitForCompletion 触发（E9）。无法从日志确认 Agent 是否读过 invocation 指引，但其代码与指引推荐的 trigger(key) 路径不同。
缺口归因

问题 1

Workflow 公开契约无法让应用在新部署中 materialize/触发自有 source workflow
NocoBase3 插件评审者判断 · 有证据重要未解决
⌄

公开的 WorkflowServiceContract 只有 registerInstruction 与 trigger(key,...)，而 trigger 只查 key+current 的 workflows 行，没有 current revision 时直接返回 { status: 'skipped', reason: 'not-found' }（E1）；materialize/激活所需的 discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized/triggerRevision 只存在于未导出的 WorkflowService，internalWorkflowServiceToken 也未从 ./server 入口再导出（E2、E3）。因此应用自有 workflow 若不先由管理员在管理 UI 启用，就无法按推荐的 trigger(key) 由业务动作触发。Agent 只能把 workflowServiceToken 断言成自建接口并调用内部方法，传 force:true 绕过启用开关、waitForCompletion:true 等待结果（E9），与 Skill 明示的“只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部”相冲突。

实际影响 / 提供的帮助
业务触发路径依赖插件内部方法与本地类型复制，公开契约与实现不一致；管理 UI 会显示启用开关为关闭，而受理动作仍能产生真实运行记录，容易让运维/后续 Agent 误判 workflow 状态。
建议改法 / 应保留的能力
为应用自有 workflow 提供并文档化公开的 materialize/activate + 触发入口（例如公开导出 internalWorkflowServiceToken 或增加 WorkflowServiceContract.materializeAndTrigger），或在 Skill 中明确“部署时必须先启用该 workflow 才能 trigger(key)”，并让管理 UI 反映应用强制触发的实际状态。

E1 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-workflow/dist/server/service.js:66–93

trigger(workflowKey) 只查 key+current 行，缺行返回 skipped:not-found，未启用且非 force/manually 返回 disabled；triggerRevision/discoverArtifacts/ensureArtifactMaterialized 均在此类，但公开契约未导出。

    async trigger(workflowKey, input, triggerOptions = {}) {
        const row = await this.collections.workflows.findOne({
            filter: { key: workflowKey, current: true },
            select: (select) => select.fields('id', 'enabled', 'hash'),
        });
        if (!row)
            return { status: 'skipped', reason: 'not-found' };
        if (!triggerOptions.force && !triggerOptions.manually && !row.enabled)
            return { status: 'skipped', reason: 'disabled' };
        if (typeof row.hash === 'string')
            await this.loader.ensureMaterialized(row.hash);
        const workflow = await loadWorkflow(this.collections, row.id);
        if (!workflow)
            throw new WorkflowInvocationError('WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND', `Workflow "${workflowKey}" was not found`);
        return this.executeRevision(workflow, input, triggerOptions);
    }
    async triggerRevision(revisionId, input, triggerOptions = {}) {
        const workflow = await loadWorkflow(this.collections, revisionId);
        if (!workflow)
            throw new WorkflowInvocationError('WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND', `Workflow revision "${String(revisionId)}" was not found`);
        return this.executeRevision(workflow, input, triggerOptions);
    }
    discoverArtifacts() {
        return this.loader.discover();
    }
    ensureArtifactMaterialized(hash) {
        return this.loader.ensureMaterialized(hash);
    }

    async run() {
        const config = readConditionConfig(this.config);
        const evaluated = config.expression === undefined
            ? true
            : evaluateJsonLogic(config.expression, this.processor.getConditionDataBindings());
        if (typeof evaluated !== 'boolean') {
            throw new TypeError(`Condition expression must evaluate to a boolean, received ${evaluated === null ? 'null' : typeof evaluated}`);
        }
        const branchKey = evaluated
            ? CONDITION_BRANCH_KEYS.yes
            : CONDITION_BRANCH_KEYS.no;
        const branch = this.processor
            .getBranches(this.node)
            .find((candidate) => candidate.branchKey === branchKey);
        const result = { status: NODE_RUN_STATUS.RESOLVED, result: evaluated };
        if (!branch)
            return result;
        const savedNodeRun = await this.processor.saveNodeRun({ ...result, nodeId: this.node.id, nodeKey: this.node.key }, this.nodeRun, {
            startedAt: this.nodeRun.startedAt,
            finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        await this.processor.run(branch, savedNodeRun);
    }

/**
 * Reject anything the nodeRun store could not round-trip through JSON: circular
 * references, BigInt, functions, symbols, non-finite numbers and class
 * instances such as an ORM model.
 */
export function assertWorkflowRunResult(value, location = 'result', ancestors = new Set()) {
    if (value === null ||
        typeof value === 'boolean' ||
        typeof value === 'string') {
        return;
    }
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
            throw new Error(`Run script ${location} is ${describe(value)} and cannot be stored`);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'object') {
        throw new Error(`Run script ${location} is ${describe(value)} and cannot be stored`);
    }
    if (ancestors.has(value)) {
        throw new Error(`Run script ${location} contains a circular reference and cannot be stored`);
    }
    ancestors.add(value);
    try {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            value.forEach((item, index) => assertWorkflowRunResult(item, `${location}[${index}]`, ancestors));
            return;
        }
        const prototype = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
        if (prototype !== Object.prototype && prototype !== null) {
            throw new Error(`Run script ${location} is ${describe(value)} and cannot be stored`);
        }
        for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(value)) {
            assertWorkflowRunResult(item, `${location}.${key}`, ancestors);

E6 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-workflow/SKILL.md:17–19

Skill 规定应用拥有 workflow 源码与触发时机，插件拥有 DSL/执行/历史/管理 API，并要求只用公开导出、不得绕过插件内部。

Use NocoBase 3's source-managed Workflow implementation where business behavior needs a durable, inspectable process lifecycle. Keep atomic operations, calculations, data access, and integrations in typed code, whether called directly or from a workflow `run` node. Do not invent DSL fields, node types, service methods, or runtime behavior.

The application owns workflow source packages, business services, trigger timing, authentication and authorization, business idempotency, and compensation policy. The plugin owns the DSL and core Instructions, Artifact and execution lifecycle, persisted history, management API, and diagnostic views. Use public package exports and APIs; do not bypass them through plugin internals or materialized tables.

const workflowRuntime = app.container.resolve(workflowServiceToken);
const receipt = await workflowRuntime.trigger(
  'quotation-decision',
  { quotationId: 'Q-100', amount: 150000 },
  { eventKey: 'quotation-submitted:Q-100' },
);
if (receipt.status === 'skipped') {
  return receipt; // caller handles the runtime result; do not poll for a run
}
const { eventKey, runId } = receipt;
```

`workflowRuntime.trigger(key, input, options?)`:

- Resolves the workflow by stable key at runtime.
- May return a `skipped` receipt. It has no `eventKey` and creates no run to poll; handle the receipt after calling rather than pre-filtering DSL keys through runtime management state.
- Requires a JSON object and validates it against the `inputSchema` declared by the selected DSL package's `workflow.ts`. Read and obey that schema before writing the trigger call; `input` is not the workflow's administrator `parameters` object.
- Rejects input over 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.
- Resolves administrator defaults/overrides into an immutable run input snapshot.
- Accepts optional `eventKey` and `parentRunId`; parent linkage is used for nested calls and stack-limit checks.
- Creates the Workflow Run and enqueues work before returning `{ status: 'accepted', eventKey, runId }` in the ordinary path; execution continues asynchronously. `runId` is the stable execution reference for status queries and integrations such as Scheduler.
- Uses event key for invocation deduplication. Reusing it must represent the same business event. If a run already exists, another trigger with that key does not execute it again; reuse is appropriate when the caller does not know whether the original submission was accepted, not as a rerun mechanism for a confirmed failure.

For a workflow that exists and is enabled, `trigger()` can still throw `INVALID_INPUT`, `INPUT_TOO_LARGE`, `PARENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND`, or `STACK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` before it returns an accepted receipt.

    const workflow = this.workflow as unknown as WorkflowRuntime;
    const artifacts = await workflow.discoverArtifacts();
    const artifact = artifacts.find(
      (item) => item.key === SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_KEY,
    );
    if (!artifact) {
      throw new ServiceRequestError(
        'SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_MISSING',
        `Workflow ${SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_KEY} is not available in this build.`,
        500,
      );
    }
    const revisionId = await workflow.ensureArtifactMaterialized(
      artifact.digest,
    );
    if (revisionId === undefined) {
      throw new ServiceRequestError(
        'SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_MISSING',
        `Workflow ${SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_KEY} could not be materialized.`,
        500,
      );
    }
    const receipt = await workflow.triggerRevision(
      revisionId,
      { requestId: id, locale: options.locale },
      {
        // The application owns this definition and runs it as part of the accept
        // action, so it is triggered regardless of the management UI switch.
        force: true,
        // The response carries the accepted record, so wait for the run rather
        // than returning a stale `pending` row to the caller.
        waitForCompletion: true,
        eventKey: `service-request-accept:${id}`,
        sourceType: 'service-request',
        sourceId: String(id),
      },
    );
    if (receipt.status === 'skipped') {
      throw new ServiceRequestError(
        'SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_SKIPPED',
        `Workflow ${SERVICE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_KEY} did not start (${receipt.reason}).`,
        500,
      );
    }
    return { runId: receipt.runId };

示例给出 inbox:{to,title,body,target:{type:'route',path}}；说明 in-app 收件人须为应用用户 id、最终投递校验用户存在、route target 由 Router 加 basename、idempotencyKey 复用规则。

Resolve `notificationServiceToken` from the shared application container. Select configured Channel names through `messages`; each value is the complete message for its Provider.

```ts
const notification = app.container.resolve(notificationServiceToken);
await notification.send({
  idempotencyKey: 'approval-123',
  source: { type: 'approval', referenceId: '123' },
  messages: {
    'system-email': {
      to: ['customer@example.com', 'reviewer@example.com'],
      subject: 'Approval result',
      html: '<p>Approved</p>',
    },
    'ops-feishu': {
      text: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'url', url: 'https://example.com/main/approvals/123' },
    },
    inbox: {
      to: '123',
      title: 'Approval result',
      body: 'Approved',
      target: { type: 'route', path: '/approvals/123' },
    },
  },
});
```

Email requires a native email address or a non-empty readonly array of addresses, a subject, and text or HTML. Each address receives a separate email and retries independently. In-app messages require application user IDs in the same string/array shape, title, and body; final delivery checks that each user still exists. Webhook messages forbid `to`. The service does not resolve application users into email addresses or phone numbers and never defaults to the current user.

IM targets accept complete HTTP(S) URLs only. In-app targets accept a route without a deployment prefix or a complete HTTP(S) URL. React Router supplies the basename once for routes; URL targets use native links. Email links belong in text/HTML. Legacy `actionUrl` is ignored.

Unknown or disabled Channels and invalid messages or recipient formats reject the entire request before persistence or queue dispatch. Delivery-time failures are recorded independently. Reuse one stable `idempotencyKey` only for the same logical request; changing messages with that key is a conflict. Optional `source` adds business correlation. Use `getByIdempotencyKey`, `getNotification`, and `onStatusChanged` to observe results. A `retrying` Delivery is waiting for automatic execution; a terminal `failed` Delivery may be passed to `retryDelivery({ deliveryId, reason })`. An `unknown` Delivery must be checked externally before creating a new logical send.

DatabaseInAppStore.list/countUnread 以 userId 过滤并按 createdAt+id 排序分页；update 读/删/改均带 userId 条件，非本人项返回 undefined；readAt 写入实现已读持久化。

    async list(input) {
        let query = this.database
            .query()
            .selectFrom('notificationInAppItems')
            .selectAll()
            .where('userId', '=', input.userId)
            .orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
            .orderBy('id', 'desc')
            .limit(input.limit ?? 25);
        if (input.unreadOnly)
            query = query.where('readAt', 'is', null);
        if (input.before)
            query = query.where((builder) => builder.or([
                builder('createdAt', '<', input.before?.createdAt),
                builder.and([
                    builder('createdAt', '=', input.before?.createdAt),
                    builder('id', '<', input.before?.id),
                ]),
            ]));
        return (await query.execute()).map(fromRow);
    }
    async countUnread(userId) {
        const rows = await this.database
            .query()
            .selectFrom('notificationInAppItems')
            .select(({ fn }) => [fn.countAll().as('count')])
            .where('userId', '=', userId)
            .where('readAt', 'is', null)
            .executeTakeFirst();
        return Number(rows?.count ?? 0);
    }
    async update(input) {
        const now = new Date().toISOString();
        if (input.action === 'delete') {
            const current = await this.database
                .query()
                .selectFrom('notificationInAppItems')
                .selectAll()
                .where('id', '=', input.id)
                .where('userId', '=', input.userId)
                .executeTakeFirst();
            if (!current)
                return undefined;
            const result = await this.database
                .query()
                .deleteFrom('notificationInAppItems')
                .where('id', '=', input.id)
                .where('userId', '=', input.userId)
                .execute();
            return result.deletedCount === 1
                ? { ...fromRow(current), updatedAt: now }
                : undefined;
        }
        const set = input.action === 'read'
            ? { readAt: now, updatedAt: now }
            : { readAt: null, updatedAt: now };
        const result = await this.database
            .query()
            .updateTable('notificationInAppItems')
            .set(set)
            .where('id', '=', input.id)
            .where('userId', '=', input.userId)
            .execute();
        if (result.updatedCount !== 1)
            return undefined;
        const row = await this.database
            .query()
            .selectFrom('notificationInAppItems')
            .selectAll()
            .where('id', '=', input.id)
            .executeTakeFirst();
        return row ? fromRow(row) : undefined;
    }

    async boot() {
        const { container } = this.app;
        if (!container.has(notificationExtensionRegistryToken))
            return;
        const registry = container.resolve(notificationExtensionRegistryToken);
        const store = container.resolve(inAppNotificationStoreToken);
        const users = container.resolve(userAdministrationServiceToken);
        registry.registerChannel(createInAppChannelDefinition()).registerProvider(createDatabaseProviderDefinition({
            store,
            async recipientExists(userId) {
                return Boolean(await users.get(userId));
            },
        }));
    }

# Workflow

1. Read [Inbox Integration Contract](references/inbox-integration.md) for package requirements, public surfaces, and runtime semantics.
2. Inspect the target application's Server plugin list, Client composition, authentication setup, `api.baseURL`, `api.realtimeURL`, and installed package versions.
3. Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification` before `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/server` when the application needs the `in-app` Channel contribution.

E24 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification-in-app/references/inbox-integration.md:10–35

契约列出必需包与注册顺序、浏览器只从 /realtime 导入 topic、客户端组件挂载在生产认证路由、Provider 写库前经 userAdministrationServiceToken 校验收件人存在。

Register the core notification Server plugin before the in-app Server plugin. The in-app routes can operate without the core plugin, but notification delivery through the `in-app` Channel cannot.

## Public surfaces

The package root and `/server` export the Server plugin and supported Server contracts. Browser or shared code imports only the topic and event types from:

```ts
import {
  IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_REALTIME_TOPIC,
  type InAppNotificationRealtimeEvent,
} from '@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/realtime';
```

Do not import `server/realtime`, store implementations, or other internal implementation paths from application code.

The package's Client plugin contributes this development-only App-relative route:

```text
/dev/notification-in-app
```

Register `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client` in the application Client composition root. The page mounts `NotificationInAppProvider` locally and cleans up its realtime and focus listeners when navigation leaves the page. The Dev Route and its exclusive dependencies are absent from production builds.

## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.

      "rootCause": "The seed/migration loader in @nocobase/db imports task files with a native dynamic import() (a file URL with an ?mtime cache-buster), which is not processed by Vite/vitest or tsx.       "rootCause": "Workflow run modules import runtime values: databaseManagerToken (@nocobase/db), notificationServiceToken (@nocobase/app-plugin-notification/server), i18nToken (@nocobase/app-server/i18n) and APP_NS (@nocobase/i18n/server). The Workflow plugin resolves the Artifact directory and loads its modules with a plain Node import(), so bare specifiers resolve by walking up from that directory. The application's default 'local' Artifact disk pointed at paths.storage(), which the deployment may relocate outside the code tree; the verify config placed it under an external repair-state directory with no reachable node_modules, so resolution failed.
